sentences.en: Great works are perfumed not by strength but by perseverance.
sentences.zh: 伟大的作品不是靠力量而是靠坚持不懈来成就的。

sentences.en: I heard that a Perfume song is used in Cars 2.
sentences.zh: 我听说《汽车总动员2》里用了一首香水歌。

sentences.en: This is the first time I've ever smelt this perfume.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次闻这种香水的味道。
